dict.string: WatchGPT reads your calendar when you ask what's on your agenda. The watch reads it out itself; it doesn't go to ChatGPT unless you turn that on.
WatchGPT reads your calendar when you ask what's on your agenda. The watch reads it out itself; it doesn't go to ChatGPT unless you turn that on.
WatchGPT finds the person you name when you ask it to call or text someone. It reads the call or text back and waits for your yes.
WatchGPT reads your sleep from Apple Health when you ask how you slept. The watch tells you itself; nothing is stored or sent to ChatGPT unless you turn that on.
